title: Large Vision-Language Models for Pediatric Motor Tic Detection: Case-Control Diagnostic Study
authors_year: Wu Y, Niu Y, Xu Z, Liu J, Jiao X, Cui X, Sun D, Yang Z; 2026
evidence_type: Peer-reviewed primary observational diagnostic-method development study
prior_preprint_date: 2026-04-19, as reported by final publisher; earlier version itself not retrieved
population: Three Chinese tertiary hospitals; ages 4–15, mean 8.3; 83 active-motor-tic cases and 85 selected healthy controls. Specific Tourette/persistent/provisional proportions and severe-adult applicability not established.
sampling_unit: Test clips are not 55 independent patients. Authors report participant-disjoint train/test assignment; exact participant counts within test and validation sets and cluster-aware uncertainty are not supplied in inspected reporting.
exposure: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct with LoRA, compared with a landmark DNN and two VideoMAE baselines on expert-selected ward-monitoring video clips.
prespecification: Prospective registration not established. Convenience cohort and validation-loss hyperparameter selection described; complete validation-set allocation not resolved.
outcomes: Binary clip detection, accuracy, recall, specificity, AUC and agreement of generated descriptors with expert tags, not treatment or functional improvement.

reported_results.auc_comparison: Reported DeLong P=.004 versus DNN; not an accuracy-difference P value.

arithmetic_limit: Three baseline accuracies in Table 2 do not map to integer correct counts out of the stated common n=55; they fit 40/54, 41/54 and 43/54. This derived consistency flag does not prove which denominator was used. Do not silently repair data or claim replicated superiority.
risk_of_bias: Selected known cases versus unusually healthy controls; exclusions for occlusion, poor quality and atypical stereotypies with exclusion count unrecorded; manually selected clips; unclear independent tuning/validation cohort; no held-out-center or home external test; possible correlated clips. Patient-wise split prevents identity overlap but alone does not demonstrate generalizability.
attrition: Preanalytic exclusion denominator not recorded; remaining variables complete after selection.
adverse_events: Not a therapeutic trial and no systematic clinical harm or net-benefit estimate. Privacy and false-positive deployment harms not validated.
funding_conflicts: Chinese national/municipal and hospital research support; no conflicts declared.
applicability: Pediatric controlled ward-video measurement evidence. No vocal-tic audio, full interference/function measurement, severe-adult validation, home deployment validation, treatment selection, disease modification or cure established.
related_cohorts: Same-study earlier JMIR preprint, not independent replication. Do not pool with repository PMID 42908833 or 42964513 because targets, sampling and validation differ; cross-study participant overlap not established.
claim_supported: Promising internal participant-disjoint motor-tic clip discrimination with uncertainty and reporting limitations.
claim_not_supported: Standalone diagnosis, prospective improvement, calibrated real-world risk, generalized all-age monitoring, biological mechanism or clinical efficacy.
full_text_status: Publisher HTML inspected transiently; CC BY 4.0 footer verified. No full paper, participant videos, photographs or individual observations retained.
license_attribution: Original article: Wu et al., JMIR AI 2026;5:e98782, DOI 10.2196/98782, https://ai.jmir.org/2026/1/e98782. Copyright the authors; CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. This record is an original paraphrase and arithmetic assessment.
correction_retraction_check: No linked correction/retraction in current PubMed metadata or publisher page inspected; not exhaustive Crossmark clearance.
reviewer: AI-assisted source extraction; not clinical peer review or model reproduction.
next_verification_task: Resolve aggregate denominators, patient/validation allocation and independent external validation before upgrading the measurement claim. Do not request or acquire participant video or deploy this model.
